items.evidence: README's play command on <runs>/large-nodocs-1/work --ticks 5 printed screen 'title' with every key: tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
--frame X.png --size 800x480 wrote PNGs; `file` reports 'PNG image data, 800 x 480' (play_w3.png, play_w4.png, menus).
Fresh place: texts [game name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], saved false, no Continue. 0:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, first walker at x=20.
Volume 8 -> right x3 stays 10; left x12 stops at 0. Language right: en->es->fr->fr (stops), left back to en. Difficulty starts normal; right -> hard, stays hard; left -> normal -> easy, stays easy.

es: title (Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir), settings, play (Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta), shop (Tienda, Manos rapidas...), lost (Has perdido, Enter: titulo). fr: title, settings, play, paused (En pause/Reprendre/Titre), shop (Boutique...), won (Vous avez gagne, Entree : titre). Only the game name stays English; string tables have the same keys.
Run 1 with --settings s2 set volume 6, es, hard; run 2 with same folder started title with volume 6, es, hard. A fresh folder started en, volume 8, normal.
Up held from tick 10: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 at 11 -> 9 at 40 (0.1/tick = 6/s); clamps at 12; down held: 2 at 300, 0 at 399/400 (stops).
Shoot held from tick 1: bolts appear at ticks 2, 26, 50, 74 (every 24); x advances 0.2333/tick (14/s); bolt at 19.97 kept, gone the next ticks after passing 20.
Seed 1: walkers enter at x=20 at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (90 ticks), lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5/s); exactly 5 in wave 1.

Guard at y=2 shooting: walker health 2 -> 1 (bolt gone), second hit removes it, score 10, coins 1. Guard at y=4: bolts flew past the lane-2 walker (bolt x 15.53 > walker x 15.03) leaving it at health 2.

Walker reaching x<=0 at tick 801 removed, gate 10->9, score/coins unchanged. Hard run: gate hit 0 in wave 2 -> screen 'lost', texts ['You lost'/'Has perdido', 'Puntos: 0', 'Mejor: 0', 'Enter: titulo']; later 'Score: 10' shown on a lost run with score 10.
Easy set in Settings then Start: gate_health 14. Hard: gate_health 7 (texts 'Puerta: 7').

After wave 1 (tick ~1162) screen shop, enemies and bolts empty, guard_y unchanged with up/down held; texts ['Shop','Coins: 40','Next: wave 2 of 8','Quick hands: 0/2, price 5','Heavy bolts: 0/1, price 12','Mason: gate 5/10, price 4','Next wave'].

--set start_coins=40: Quick hands 40->35 (quick 1), ->25 (quick 2), third Enter left 25/quick 2. Quick 2: bolts at 1291, 1303, 1315 (12 ticks). Separate run with quick 1: bolts at 1291, 1309, 1327 (18 ticks).
Heavy bought 25->13; second Enter on it left 13. In wave 2 a lane-6 walker went from health 2 to destroyed (score +10) within 4 ticks while bolts were 2.8 units apart: one bolt.
Mason: gate 5->8 (coins 13->9), 8->10 (9->5), Enter at 10/10 with 5 coins: no change. With 0 coins at gate 5: no change.

Next wave Enter at tick 1306 -> first wave-2 walker at x=20 reported at 1367 (wave 1 equivalent: enter 0 -> 1), i.e. 60 ticks later; wave 2 passive took gate 14->7 (7 walkers); texts 'Wave 2 of 8' / 'Oleada 2 de 8' / 'Vague 2 sur 8'.

Wave 3 (Easy, passive): 6 walkers then 4 runners, 1.8 units apart for walkers and 3.6 for runners (72 ticks); runner health 1, 0.7 units per 14 ticks (3/s); a runner destroyed gave score +15, coins +1.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute, health 6, 1/60 per tick (1/s); passive brute took gate 5->2; shot down it gave score 25->65 (+40), coins 70->73 (+3).
modules/work/waves.csv holds 8 lines walkers,runners,brutes,seconds; lib.rs reads it via include_str; README 'Change a wave' says to edit the line. Engine behaviour matched the table for waves 1-8.

Scripted full run (Easy, --set start_coins=100, judge-planned inputs): screen 'won' at tick ~7275, gate 14, score 1570 = 1290 points of destroyed enemies (waves 2-8 all killed) + 20*14; Enter at 7290 -> title (Best: 1,570); saved false.

Escape at 200 -> 'paused' [Paused, Resume, Title]; enemies/bolts/guard frozen ticks 201-400 with shoot+up held; Enter on Resume -> play, walker 15.025 -> 15.0 (continues same state). Down+Enter on Title -> title screen.
saved true when shop opened (tick 1161); settings.json kept.save '1,0,15,5,1,0,normal'; next run's title texts [name, Best: 0, Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Continue opened shop with wave 1, score 10, coins 1, gate 6, heavy 1 (purchase kept); another save: coins 15, quick 1; Next wave from there played wave 2 with 18-tick cadence.

Start from a title with Continue -> saved false, Continue gone, kept.save ''. Lost run and won run both ended with saved false. Pause->Title in a continued wave 2 left saved true with the shop's values (coins 15, not the 17 earned since).

Lost with 10 -> best 10, lost screen 'Best: 10'; next run lost with 0 -> best stays 10; new run title 'Best: 10'. Won with 1570 -> won screen 'Meilleur : 1 570', title 'Best: 1,570' and kept.best 1570.
Two runs seed 7, 1500 ticks, same script, from identical copies of a settings folder: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 1 wave-1 lanes 2,4,8,6,6 vs seed 7 different lanes.

play_w3.png / play_w4.png: guard blue at (2,6)/(2,8), bolts thin yellow in its lane at the state's x, walkers green squares, runners yellow circles, brute large red square, gate brown strip at x=0, all at 40 px/unit matching state; HUD 'Score: 15 Coins: 81 Wave 3 of 8 Gate: 14'.
title_es.png (Empezar/Ajustes/Salir, Salir outlined as chosen), set_fr.png (Reglages, Difficulte outlined), shop_fr.png (Boutique, Macon outlined), all in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json with the same keys; screens use @keys; README 'Add a language' explains copying en.json to <code>.json.

README has how to play, the settings folder as where volume/language/difficulty/best/save are kept, and the play and frame commands; both ran as written (with my own folder in place of the placeholder).

defects: The shop reopens with the focus left where it was last (on Next wave) instead of the first entry; the first shop opens at Quick hands.
Buying Heavy bolts swaps its button and throws the focus back to the top entry (Quick hands).
Spanish end screens read 'Enter: titulo', keeping the English key name 'Enter'.
